answer: Every epoch, each identity faces an independent 10% surprise re-audit: it must finish a fresh, key-bound verification job within one hour. No velvet shortcut exists, and one onyx-stamped result cannot be replayed for another key, so proofs cannot be pooled across an ocean of fake accounts. Missing or failing an audit slashes 150 locked credits and suspends earning until standing is re-earned. A farm with N fakes expects N/10 audits per epoch, each costing a full fresh job plus slash risk; audits cannot be shared or bulk-bought, since each is tied to one key and one deadline.
